params.body:
## What

With a project open in Netwerk the right column stacked the project's header, its whole handover panel and a list of up to 25 relations, and a relation opened before stayed under it. The column ran far below the graph, and it was still not obvious which handover belonged to what.

- **One thing open at a time.** Opening a project closes the relation and the other way round.
- **One card per open item.** The card shows the type ("Project" or "Relatie"), the name and its details, then two tabs:
  - a project has **Overdracht** and **Relaties 24**, with the count in red when someone is missing a taker; the Relaties tab says "Elke relatie heeft haar eigen overdracht; tik om ze te openen";
  - a relation has **Overdracht** and **Werkt samen met 8**, listing who takes over each of those relations and how many projects they share.
- Only one tab shows at a time, so the column stays about as high as the graph. The handover stays mounted while the other tab is open, so nothing typed is lost.
- The handover panel gets a `heading` option; inside the card it drops its own heading and border, since the card already says what it is for.

## Checks

- 354 PHP tests and pint pass. A new test covers one item open at a time and the tabs for both types.
- Checked on a demo copy: project on both tabs, relation.
